product_scope: itpay is the single public Buyer CLI entry point, and $itpay is its user-facing Skill invocation. It covers services, railway planning and booking, orders, authorized purchased content and refunds.
title: Read The Original Checkout
purpose: Read official Checkout and payment facts after its entry was delivered.
when_to_use: The current purchase flow returned an official human handoff.
The agent restarted or lost the Checkout output before payment was confirmed.
current_flow: The Skill owns immediate human handoff. The displayed page is not proof of payment.
Use the already-returned same-Checkout reader; never expose its embedded credentials separately.
Payment pending/unknown means read the original Checkout/Order only. No replacement purchase or repeated payment.
Verified payment creates the original Order; read its actual fulfillment. Payment does not mean all tickets issued or a report delivered.
